extension.summary: CR-delimited ASCII TCP control bridge for control systems
extension.description: Listens on a TCP socket and accepts plain CR-delimited ASCII commands (UP, DOWN, PAGEUP, PLAY, PAUSE...), translating them into Kodi actions. Pushes unsolicited state feedback back to every connected client: transport state, now-playing metadata, elapsed time, and a 0-65535 progress ramp suitable for driving an analog gauge. Intended for Crestron, AMX, Control4 or any control system that speaks raw sockets but does not want to parse JSON.
extension.news: v1.0.0 - Initial release as Kodi TCP Bridge.
